dataset.label: SP500 Communication Services training-fixed PC1 residual

pca.loadings: fixed leading covariance eigenvector estimated from training dates only
pca.missing_training_returns: stock training mean imputation for PCA only
pca.factor_score: current observed eligible stocks, least-squares projection
pca.OOS_target: residual distribution; not unconditional raw-return forecast

specification.reference: symmetric standardized Student t; lambda exactly zero
specification.models: M1 static t; M2 location/scale; M3 eta after M2; M4 even/odd after M2; M5 even/odd after M3
specification.likelihood: sum of daily cross-sectional mean log densities; equal date weights
specification.drivers: daily means, HAR(1,5,22), zero presample scores
specification.projection: fixed fitted M1 geometry, remove location/log variance only; no whitening
specification.inference: fixed-upstream daily-cluster sandwich Wald, bandwidth zero
specification.wald_weights: daily mean parameter scores and matching daily mean Hessian; lag 0
